[LGRA.8.2] `type_ref` and `binding` are both `NAME`, separated by grammatical
**position** ([LGRA.22]): `type_ref` heads the pattern body and resolves as a
schema reference — a bare local/imported `NAME`, or a library-qualified
`lib.Schema` ([LGRA.22.4]); `binding` is the optional trailing `NAME` ([LGRA.8.6]).
`within_clause` / `where_clause` are optional. An adapter entity is matched by
constraining its identity slot in the `where` clause (`where entity_id ~ /…/`),
not by a dotted entity-suffix ([LADP.2]).
